mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,crmp_periodo as timeFrame ,(select cptm_codigo from account.periodotiempo_ptm where cptm_llave = crmp_periodo) as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_estado as state from x_${catalog}_${type}_rmp inner join cuenta_cue on (ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta)
mapper.select: select mrmp_saldosiguiente from account.periodotiempo_ptm pts inner join account.periodotiempo_ptm pt_ant on (pt_ant.nptm_nivel = pts.nptm_nivel and pt_ant.dptm_fechainicio < pts.dptm_fechainicio) inner join account.maparesultados_rmp rmp on (crmp_periodo = pt_ant.cptm_llave and crmp_cuenta = '${accountId}') where pts.cptm_llave = '${timeFrameId}' order by pt_ant.dptm_fechainicio desc limit 1

select crmp_llave as key ,ccue_llave as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,cptm_llave as timeFrame ,cptm_codigo as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_estado as state from account.cuenta_cue left join account.periodotiempo_ptm on ( nptm_nivel = 0) left join account.maparesultados_rmp on (crmp_cuenta = ccue_llave and crmp_periodo = cptm_llave) where ccue_catalogo = '${catalogId}' and ncue_nivel = 1 and ccue_estado = 'A' order by ccue_wbs

select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,cptm_llave as timeFrame ,cptm_codigo as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value from account.periodotiempo_ptm left join account.maparesultados_rmp on ( crmp_periodo = cptm_llave and (crmp_cuenta = '${accountId}' or crmp_cuenta is null)) where (nptm_nivel = 0 or (nptm_nivel = 1 and nptm_ano = ${year}) or (nptm_nivel = 2 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month}) or (nptm_nivel = 3 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day}) or (nptm_nivel = 4 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day} and nptm_hora = ${hour}) or (nptm_nivel = 5 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day} and nptm_hora = ${hour} and nptm_minuto = ${minute}) )

update account.maparesultados_rmp set nrmp_cantidad = #{item.quantity}, mrmp_positivo = #{item.positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{item.negative}, mrmp_valor = #{item.value}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = #{item.nextBalance} where crmp_llave =#{item.key}

update account.maparesultados_rmp set mrmp_saldoanterior = mrmp_saldoanterior + #{value}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = mrmp_saldosiguiente + #{value} where crmp_cuenta = #{accountId} and crmp_estado = 'A' and crmp_periodo in ( select cptm_llave from account.periodotiempo_ptm where nptm_nivel = #{level} and dptm_fechainicio > #{startDate})
